{{Top|leg}}
An '''ion cell''' was a modified [[Energy cell (vibroblade)|energy cell]] that was used to augment many types of [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]] by discharging ions along the length of the blade. The Mark II, III, & IV versions in turn allowed for a considerable increase in the potential for ionic damage.
